speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with progressive swelling and pain in your right ring finger; can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if they started after any specific injury or insect bite?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Closed Finger Fracture (Boxer's Fracture) or Severe Dislocation.

The mechanism of injury—forceful flexion against a jersey pull—is classic for a 5th metacarpal fracture or a complex dislocation. Given the progressive swelling and pain starting two days ago, I need to confirm the structural integrity of the bone.

REQUEST TEST: Right Hand X-Ray (AP and Lateral views).
REQUEST IMAGES: Right Hand X-Ray results.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
